title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Bundle Credit by Whether Alarms Are Still Watched
content:
## Portfolio Q&A

**What decides the building automation bundle credit on a renewal of a Preventive Maintenance Agreements record?** Whether the building automation service plan at the building, held under the Building Automation Service Plans, is still watching alarms — that is, whether it stands in active status and whether its alarm allowance still carries responses.

**How much is taken off?**

| The plan | Building automation bundle credit taken off |
|---|---|
| stands in active status and still carries alarm responses in its allowance | the tier's bundle credit in full |
| stands in active status and its alarm allowance is exhausted | the tier's bundle credit at the exhausted bundle share, that is 50 percent of it |
| the owner holds no building automation service plan in active status | no building automation bundle credit |

**Where does "exhausted" fall?** An allowance standing above nothing still carries alarm responses; one standing at nothing or less is exhausted.

**Which figure is the tier's bundle credit?** The annual credit published for the agreement's own tier on the annual price list — nothing at the three lower tiers, and the published figure at the three upper ones.

**Worked case (hypothetical).** At a tier whose published bundle credit is 600.00 USD: 600.00 USD is taken off where the building's automation plan is active with alarm responses left, 300.00 USD where that plan is active with its allowance exhausted, and nothing where no such plan stands active.
